title: Approximating an Ideal Experiment with Induced Order Statistics
abstract: arXiv:2603.07255v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many economic questions concern the conditional distribution of an outcome at a fixed covariate value. We refer to observing i.i.d.\ draws from this distribution as an \emph{ideal experiment}, under which many statistical procedures admit exact, finite-sample guarantees. When the covariate is continuously distributed, however, this ideal experiment is unavailable. We provide a general method for approximating this ideal experiment using \emph{induced order statistics}, the outcomes attached to the nearest observed covariates. We derive explicit bounds on the approximation error in Hellinger and total variation distances. These bounds quantify how local approximation errors accumulate as the nearest-neighbor sample grows and provide a unified way to transfer rejection and coverage guarantees across statistical procedures. Under quadratic mean differentiability and local regularity of the covariate distribution, the bounds apply to bot

translated_title: 用诱导顺序统计量逼近理想实验
translated_abstract: 许多经济问题涉及结果变量在固定协变量取值处的条件分布。我们将从该分布中观测到独立同分布抽样的情形称为“理想实验”，在此实验下许多统计方法可以获得精确的有限样本保证。然而，当协变量服从连续分布时，这种理想实验是无法直接实现的。我们提出了一种利用“诱导顺序统计量”（即与最近观测协变量相匹配的结果）来逼近该理想实验的一般方法。我们推导出了逼近误差在 Hellinger 距离和全变差距离下的显式界。这些界刻画了随着近邻样本的增长，局部逼近误差如何累积，并为在各种统计方法之间传递拒绝与覆盖保证提供了统一途径。在二次均值可微性和协变量分布局部正则性的条件下，这些界既适用于（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用诱导顺序统计量（最近邻协变量对应的结果）来逼近固定协变量取值处的理想实验，并推导出 Hellinger 距离与全变差距离下逼近误差的显式界，从而为跨统计方法统一传递有限样本的拒绝与覆盖保证提供了通用框架。
en_tdlr: This paper approximates the ideal experiment of observing i.i.d. draws at a fixed covariate value using induced order statistics, deriving explicit Hellinger and total variation error bounds that provide a unified framework for transferring finite-sample rejection and coverage guarantees across statistical procedures.
